name: WorldPartition3D
author: Twillion
shortDescription: Cartesian sector grid streaming, concentric geometry clipmap terrain, delta-state persistence, and HLOD proxies.
description: A unified open-world architecture combining 50k constant-triangle concentric Geometry Clipmap terrain, background Cartesian sector grid streaming with LRU cache eviction, delta-state world persistence (saved looted chests/dead enemies), and distant sector HLOD proxy swapping.

eventsBasedBehaviors.name: WorldPartition3D
eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Coordinates world sector grid streaming, clipmap terrain rings, and persistent world state.

propertyDescriptors.name: SectorSize
propertyDescriptors.label: Sector Size (Meters)
propertyDescriptors.description: Width and height of each Cartesian world grid sector in meters.

propertyDescriptors.name: NearStreamingRadius
propertyDescriptors.label: Near Streaming Radius (Meters)
propertyDescriptors.description: Distance in meters where full dynamic objects, physics, and AI are active.

propertyDescriptors.name: FarStreamingRadius
propertyDescriptors.label: Far Horizon Radius (Meters)
propertyDescriptors.description: Outer horizon distance in meters where distant sectors are tracked.

propertyDescriptors.name: MaxVRAMBudgetMB
propertyDescriptors.label: Max VRAM Budget (MB)
propertyDescriptors.description: Memory threshold for LRU cache eviction of inactive sectors.

propertyDescriptors.name: EnableHLOD
propertyDescriptors.label: Enable Distant HLOD Proxies
propertyDescriptors.description: Merges distant static props into single low-poly proxy meshes per sector.

propertyDescriptors.name: HLODDistanceThreshold
propertyDescriptors.label: HLOD Swap Distance (Meters)
propertyDescriptors.description: Distance in meters where individual meshes swap to the merged HLOD proxy.

propertyDescriptors.name: EnableClipmapTerrain
propertyDescriptors.label: Enable Clipmap Terrain
propertyDescriptors.description: Enables 4–6 nested concentric geometry rings with GPU height displacement.

propertyDescriptors.name: ClipmapRingLevels
propertyDescriptors.label: Clipmap Ring Levels
propertyDescriptors.description: Number of concentric ring levels (4, 5, or 6).

propertyDescriptors.name: HeightmapTexture
propertyDescriptors.label: Heightmap Texture Resource
propertyDescriptors.description: 16-bit elevation heightmap texture for world terrain.

propertyDescriptors.name: HeightmapScaleZ
propertyDescriptors.label: Heightmap Scale Z (Meters)
propertyDescriptors.description: Maximum vertical mountain height in meters (0 - 2000).

propertyDescriptors.name: EnableDeltaPersistence
propertyDescriptors.label: Enable Delta-State Persistence
propertyDescriptors.description: Remembers dynamic state changes (looted chests, dead enemies, broken doors).

propertyDescriptors.name: AutoSaveToStorage
propertyDescriptors.label: Auto Save to Storage
propertyDescriptors.description: Automatically serializes delta state to IndexedDB / localStorage.

eventsFunctions.name: onCreated
eventsFunctions.description: Initializes the WorldPartition3D grid streaming and clipmap terrain engine.

eventsFunctions.name: doStepPostEvents
eventsFunctions.description: Updates active streaming sectors and toroidal clipmap terrain position.

eventsFunctions.name: onDestroy
eventsFunctions.description: Cleans up WorldPartition3D resources.

events.inlineCode: // Clean up state

eventsFunctions.name: SetStreamingRadii
eventsFunctions.description: Updates the near and far streaming radii in meters.

parameters.name: NearRadius
parameters.description: Near dynamic streaming radius in meters (e.g. 256.0)

parameters.name: FarRadius
parameters.description: Far horizon streaming radius in meters (e.g. 1500.0)

eventsFunctions.name: PreloadSector
eventsFunctions.sentence: Preload sector at coordinates on _PARAM0_ (SectorX: _PARAM1_, SectorY: _PARAM2_)
eventsFunctions.description: Asynchronously loads a target chunk before cutscenes or teleports.

eventsFunctions.name: EvictSector
eventsFunctions.sentence: Evict sector at coordinates on _PARAM0_ (SectorX: _PARAM1_, SectorY: _PARAM2_)
eventsFunctions.description: Manually purges a sector from active memory.

eventsFunctions.name: SaveObjectStateString
eventsFunctions.sentence: Save object state string on _PARAM0_ (ObjectID: _PARAM1_, Key: _PARAM2_, Value: _PARAM3_)
eventsFunctions.description: Records a persistent string property for an object across sector unloads.

parameters.name: ObjectID
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the entity (e.g. chest_04)

eventsFunctions.name: SaveObjectStateNumber
eventsFunctions.sentence: Save object state number on _PARAM0_ (ObjectID: _PARAM1_, Key: _PARAM2_, Value: _PARAM3_)
eventsFunctions.description: Records a persistent numeric property for an object across sector unloads.

eventsFunctions.name: SaveObjectStateBoolean
eventsFunctions.sentence: Save object state boolean on _PARAM0_ (ObjectID: _PARAM1_, Key: _PARAM2_, Value: _PARAM3_)
eventsFunctions.description: Records a persistent boolean flag for an object across sector unloads.

eventsFunctions.name: SaveWorldDeltaState
eventsFunctions.fullName: Save world delta state to disk
eventsFunctions.sentence: Save world delta state to disk on _PARAM0_ (SaveSlot: _PARAM1_)
eventsFunctions.description: Serializes entire world state history to localStorage / IndexedDB.

eventsFunctions.name: LoadWorldDeltaState
eventsFunctions.fullName: Load world delta state from disk
eventsFunctions.sentence: Load world delta state from disk on _PARAM0_ (SaveSlot: _PARAM1_)
eventsFunctions.description: Restores world state progress from disk on game load.

eventsFunctions.name: ClearWorldDeltaHistory
eventsFunctions.sentence: Clear world delta state history on _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Resets all world memory modifications for a New Game.

eventsFunctions.name: IsSectorLoaded
eventsFunctions.sentence: Is sector loaded at coordinates (_PARAM1_, _PARAM2_) on _PARAM0_

eventsFunctions.name: IsObjectStateSaved
eventsFunctions.sentence: Is object state key saved on _PARAM0_ (ObjectID: _PARAM1_, Key: _PARAM2_)
eventsFunctions.description: Returns true if the entity has a saved state override in world memory.

eventsFunctions.name: IsObjectStateBooleanTrue
eventsFunctions.sentence: Is object state boolean true on _PARAM0_ (ObjectID: _PARAM1_, Key: _PARAM2_)

eventsFunctions.name: CurrentSectorX
eventsFunctions.sentence: Get current player sector grid X on _PARAM0_

eventsFunctions.name: CurrentSectorY
eventsFunctions.sentence: Get current player sector grid Y on _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the player's current sector grid Y coordinate.

eventsFunctions.name: ActiveSectorCount
eventsFunctions.sentence: Get number of active loaded sectors on _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the number of active streaming sectors currently held in memory.

eventsFunctions.name: ActiveHLODProxyCount
eventsFunctions.sentence: Get number of active HLOD proxy meshes on _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the number of active distant HLOD single-mesh proxies.

eventsFunctions.name: GetObjectStateString
eventsFunctions.sentence: Get saved string property on _PARAM0_ (ObjectID: _PARAM1_, Key: _PARAM2_)
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the saved string property for the specified entity from world memory.

eventsFunctions.name: GetObjectStateNumber
eventsFunctions.sentence: Get saved numeric property on _PARAM0_ (ObjectID: _PARAM1_, Key: _PARAM2_)
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the saved numeric property for the specified entity from world memory.
